Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Emil Quintero | DOB: 07/12/1989 | MRN: SYN-3569369
Date of service: 03/11/2025 | Dr. Felix Cordero, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
35-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2021, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: gastroesophageal reflux, hypothyroidism.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 20 mg weekly for 27 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 5.1 (moderate disease activity).
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
